## SIA licence verification (mandatory)

| Check | Result | By | Date |
|-------|--------|-----|------|
| Licence number provided by candidate (16 digits) | | | |
| Search 1 — by number — name on register | | | |
| Search 1 — status | | | |
| Search 1 — sector | | | |
| Search 1 — expiry | | | |
| Search 2 — by name/DOB — number on register | | | |
| Numbers match (Search 1 = Search 2)? | ☐ Y ☐ N | | |
| Name matches photo ID? | ☐ Y ☐ N | | |
| Face matches licence card (in person/live)? | ☐ Y ☐ N | | |
| Screenshot refs | | | |

**SIA outcome:** ☐ PASS ☐ FAIL — Reason if fail: _________________________________

Register: [services.sia.homeoffice.gov.uk/rolh](https://services.sia.homeoffice.gov.uk/rolh/)
